import Port4C_PrefixMeaning
import Port4C_BatchInverse
import LPf_BaseMultiply
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBS_GeometryDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std AspisR1
/-- All real geometry sizes, including empty ranges; no allocation success
or result vector is assumed. TX2 uses start10/end22. -/
theorem sizes (start stop : Nat) (order : start≤stop) (hi : stop≤22) :
    stop-start≤22 ∧ (stop-start)*5≤110 ∧
    (start=10 → stop-start≤12 ∧ (stop-start)*5≤60) := by omega

theorem aligned (u : Nat) (bound : u<262144) :
    u/4*4<262144 ∧ u/4*4+3<262144 ∧
    u/4*4≤u ∧ u≤u/4*4+3 := by omega

/-- A selected record is exactly five consecutive entries in the SAME flat
vector. This also proves the allocation/index arithmetic does not overflow. -/
theorem group (n i j : Nat) (hn : n≤22) (hi : i<n) (hj : j<5) :
    5*i+j<5*n ∧ 5*i+j<110 ∧ 5*i+j<18446744073709551616 := by omega

theorem accessor (start count index : Nat) (lo : start ≤ index) (hi : index<start+count) :
    index-start<count ∧ start+(index-start)=index := by omega

/-- Accepted zero checks and canonicality imply nonzero natural residues,
so a successful native path never inverts field zero. -/
theorem nonzero (word : Nat) (canonical : word<2147483647) (guard : word≠0) :
    word%2147483647≠0 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt canonical];exact guard

#print axioms sizes
#print axioms aligned
#print axioms group
#print axioms accessor
#print axioms nonzero
#print axioms AspisR1.Port4C_PrefixMeaning.total
#print axioms AspisR1.Port4C_BatchInverse.backward_exact
end NBS_GeometryDomains

NCB_PrefixNativeStep.text:
import Port4C_PrefixMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NCB_PrefixNativeStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open AspisR1.Port4C_NativePrefix S7Kani2PrefixLoop
/-- Three local native cuts compose at ONE arbitrary prefix prestate.
The read, append frame and modular reply are tied to the same flat/index/product.
Ownership and the native whole-loop trace are not assumed or concluded. -/
theorem source (ops : Leaves)
    (multiply : ops.mul=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes after : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product productAfter : U32) (index : Usize)
    (size : flat.val.length≤110) (active : index.val<flat.val.length)
    (capacity : prefixes.val.length≤110)
    (nativePush : after.val=prefixes.val++[product])
    (nativeMul : productAfter.val=(product.val*(flat.val[index.val]'active).val)%2147483647) :
    ∃ next : Usize, next.val=index.val+1 ∧
      verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body ops flat prefixes product index=
        ok (cont (after,productAfter,next)) := by
  obtain ⟨x,read,word⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Slice.index_usize_spec flat index active)
  obtain ⟨next,push,contents⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.vec.Vec.push_spec prefixes product (by
      have h : 110<Usize.max := by scalar_tac
      omega))
  have same : next=after := Subtype.ext (contents.trans nativePush.symm)
  subst next
  have value : wordMul product x=productAfter := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change (product.val*x.val)%2147483647=productAfter.val
    change x=flat.val[index.val] at word
    rw [word]
    exact nativeMul.symm
  let next := Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize
  refine ⟨next,Port3_Wrapping.increment index (by omega),?_⟩
  have running : index<Slice.len flat := active
  simp only [verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body,if_pos running,read,push,
    multiply,multiply_word,value,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

theorem stopped (ops : Leaves) (flat : Slice U32) (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (product : U32) (index : Usize) (stop : flat.val.length ≤ index.val) :
    verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body ops flat prefixes product index=
      ok (done (prefixes,product)) := by
  have inactive : ¬index<Slice.len flat := by change ¬index.val<flat.val.length;omega
  simp only [verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop.body,if_neg inactive]
#print axioms source
#print axioms stopped
end NCB_PrefixNativeStep
end

NCB_PrefixCutTrace.text:
import NCB_PrefixNativeStep
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NCB_PrefixCutTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open AspisR1.Port4C_NativePrefix
/-- Ordered local observations of one actual buffer carrier. Each edge records
only the append frame and modular field reply, not a whole model loop result.
Existence for a frozen native execution remains a separate bridge obligation. -/
inductive Cuts (flat : Slice U32) : Usize → alloc.vec.Vec U32 → U32 →
    alloc.vec.Vec U32 → U32 → Prop
  | done (index : Usize) (buffer : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product : U32)
      (stop : flat.val.length=index.val) : Cuts flat index buffer product buffer product
  | step (index : Usize) (buffer next final : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product nextProduct finalProduct : U32)
      (active : index.val<flat.val.length)
      (pushed : next.val=buffer.val++[product])
      (multiplied : nextProduct.val=(product.val*(flat.val[index.val]'active).val)%2147483647)
      (tail : Cuts flat (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize) next nextProduct final finalProduct) :
      Cuts flat index buffer product final finalProduct

theorem associated (ops : Leaves)
    (multiply : ops.mul=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (flat : Slice U32) (size : flat.val.length≤110)
    (index : Usize) (buffer final : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product finalProduct : U32)
    (cuts : Cuts flat index buffer product final finalProduct)
    (length : buffer.val.length=index.val) :
    verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop ops flat buffer product index=ok (final,finalProduct) := by
  induction cuts with
  | done index buffer product stop =>
    have body := NCB_PrefixNativeStep.stopped ops flat buffer product index (by omega)
    unfold verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,body]
  | step index buffer next final product nextProduct finalProduct active pushed multiplied tail ih =>
    have inc := Port3_Wrapping.increment index (by omega)
    have nextLen : next.val.length=(Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val := by
      rw [pushed,List.length_append,List.length_singleton,length,inc]
    have tailRun := ih nextLen
    obtain ⟨cursor,cursorVal,body⟩ := NCB_PrefixNativeStep.source ops multiply flat buffer next
      product nextProduct index size active (by omega) pushed multiplied
    have cursorEq : cursor=Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (cursorVal.trans inc.symm)
    rw [cursorEq] at body
    unfold verifier.batch_prefix_products_loop
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,body]
    exact tailRun

/-- Reuse the existing complete buffer meaning theorem after associating the
ordered cuts. This adds no independently chosen native result or product. -/
theorem meaning (ops : Leaves)
    (multiply : ops.mul=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (one : ops.one=ok (1#u32)) (flat : Slice U32) (size : flat.val.length≤110)
    (final : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (finalProduct : U32)
    (cuts : Cuts flat 0#usize (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) 1#u32 final finalProduct) :
    (final.val,finalProduct)=S7Kani2PrefixLoop.model flat.val [] 1#u32 := by
  have run := associated ops multiply flat size 0#usize (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) final
    1#u32 finalProduct cuts rfl
  obtain ⟨out,product,source,value⟩ := Port4C_PrefixMeaning.total ops multiply one flat size
  have entry : verifier.batch_prefix_products ops flat=ok (final,finalProduct) := by
    simp only [verifier.batch_prefix_products,one,bind_tc_ok,alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity]
    exact run
  have same := Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj (source.symm.trans entry))
  rcases same with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  exact value
#print axioms associated
#print axioms meaning
end NCB_PrefixCutTrace
end

import LPi_TowerValues
import LPf_WideConstruction
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBG_WideCarriers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 LPi_FieldValues

theorem wide_add (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y = ok z ∧
      canonE z ∧ ew z = (addQ (qw x.c0) (qw y.c0), addQ (qw x.c1) (qw y.c1)) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.qm_add x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,vb⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.qm_add x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,
    ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩

theorem limbs_result (a b c d e f g h : U32) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
      (Array.make 8#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]) =
      ok (if a < 2147483647#u32 ∧ b < 2147483647#u32 ∧ c < 2147483647#u32 ∧
        d < 2147483647#u32 ∧ e < 2147483647#u32 ∧ f < 2147483647#u32 ∧
        g < 2147483647#u32 ∧ h < 2147483647#u32
        then some (LPf_WideConstruction.value a b c d e f g h) else none) := by
  simp [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs,
    Array.index_usize,Array.make,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,LPf_WideConstruction.value]
  repeat' split
  all_goals simp_all <;> omega

theorem to_limbs_result (x : NE) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_limbs x =
      ok (Array.make 8#usize [x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b,x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b,
        x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b,x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b]) := rfl

/-- Wrong lengths reject before any byte index, for arbitrary machine slices. -/
theorem wrong_byte_length (bytes : Slice U8) (h : bytes.val.length ≠ 32) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes bytes = ok none := by
  have hn : Slice.len bytes != 32#usize := by
    simp only [bne_iff_ne]
    intro eq
    have values := congrArg UScalar.val eq
    apply h
    change bytes.val.length = 32 at values
    exact values
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.BYTE_LEN,hn,if_true]

abbrev PQ := AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.QM31
abbrev PE := AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact
def pw (x : PQ) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (x.c0.a.val,x.c0.b.val,x.c1.a.val,x.c1.b.val)
def reduced (x : PQ) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (x.c0.a.val%2147483647,x.c0.b.val%2147483647,
   x.c1.a.val%2147483647,x.c1.b.val%2147483647)

theorem remainder (x : U32) : ∃ z, x % 2147483647#u32 = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 :=
  WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec x (y:=2147483647#u32) (by decide))

theorem canonical_qm31 (x : PQ) : ∃ z,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31 x = ok z ∧ pw z = reduced x := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va⟩ := remainder x.c0.a
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb⟩ := remainder x.c0.b
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := remainder x.c1.a
  obtain ⟨d,hd,vd⟩ := remainder x.c1.b
  refine ⟨⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩,?_,Prod.ext va (Prod.ext vb (Prod.ext vc vd))⟩
  simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleM31M31.call,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.P,ha,hb,hc,hd,bind_tc_ok]

theorem wide_new (x y : PQ) : ∃ z : PE,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact.new x y = ok z ∧
      (pw z.c0,pw z.c1) = (reduced x,reduced y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va⟩ := canonical_qm31 x
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb⟩ := canonical_qm31 y
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact.new,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],
    Prod.ext va vb⟩

#print axioms wide_add
#print axioms limbs_result
#print axioms to_limbs_result
#print axioms wrong_byte_length
#print axioms remainder
#print axioms canonical_qm31
#print axioms wide_new
end NBG_WideCarriers
